info.description:
Grounded retrieval augmented generation for the Vet2Employ AI Manager.

Every output is generated from retrieved evidence only, every claim carries citations, and
every response is verified before it is returned. When the knowledge base cannot support a
request the service abstains instead of guessing.

Every error response uses the same envelope: `error` (a stable code), `message`, `details`
and `request_id`.
info.title: Vet2Employ RAG Service

delete.description:
Remove a document with its chunks and records. Remove or replace its source file as
well, otherwise the next directory ingestion will add it back.

post.description:
Ingest every supported file in the configured knowledge base directory in the
background. Unchanged files are skipped unless ``force`` is true. With ``prune``,
documents whose source file has been removed from the directory are deleted.

409.description: A run is already in progress

get.description: Valid filter values and a summary of what the knowledge base contains.

Deterministic profile of a role computed from structured research records: posting
counts, the most common skills and tools, and employee culture ratings. No model involved.

post.description:
Answers only from evidence. When evidence does not cover the question the manager
abstains in character and flags the conversation for human review. Messages that match
the safeguarding screen always set ``reply.needs_human_review``; crisis messages are
answered with a fixed support message without calling a model.
